brief:
# Headless sessions get the brief only (Brett)

Headless builds (deploy/claude-headless.sh, claude -p) must NOT load CLAUDE.md, the CLAUDE.md chain, memory folders, rules files or any auto-loaded context. The ONLY input is the brief the orchestrator writes: exactly what that job needs, nothing more.

1. Stop all auto-loaded context in headless runs: no CLAUDE.md / chain / user or project memory / settings-injected instructions. Use Claude Code's options for this (setting sources, custom system prompt, strict MCP config, etc.); verify in the log what actually loads.
2. Load only the MCP servers and tools the job needs (default none); cut the ~31K start tokens as far as possible.
3. Orchestrator writes self-contained briefs: it pulls only the relevant rules, file paths and context for that job into the brief (rule snippets by tag, not whole files). Brief template + a size budget with a warning when exceeded.
4. Measure: start tokens before vs after on a sample build; show per-build start tokens and cost in the console.
5. Look at the unlanded token-optimize and md-chain-default branches and reuse what fits; note what's superseded.

## Rules
Settings in categorized collapsible sections (toggle, budget); voice + API/MCP/CLI parity; tests; report, STATUS, THREADS.

steps.text: Brief-only launch profile: core + CLI (no CLAUDE.md / memory / setting sources / hooks that inject; MCP default none)
Launcher: run headless claude with the profile; log what actually loads (init event: tools, MCP, memory files)
Self-contained briefs: rule snippets by tag (rules-brief@1 from token-optimize), brief template, size budget with warning
Measure start tokens before vs after on a sample build; meter records start tokens
Console: per-build start tokens + cost; settings section (toggle, budget, MCP list) with API/MCP/CLI/voice parity
Tests, report, STATUS, THREADS; note what token-optimize / md-chain-control parts are superseded

tests.name: New framework/spec/check-headless-context.mjs (38 checks, in CI): plan, settings cleaning, variadic = forms, lean hooks (muted keep stdin), MCP needs / skipped without token, init summary, start tokens, budget, rules by tag, empty template heading, run-note parsing, CLI line protocol, launcher wirin
Real runs: measure full vs brief (above); an end-to-end deploy/claude-headless.sh launch in tmux (log line, meter start + context, hooks fired); MCP-with---tools probe.

Unchanged and green: check-theme, check-controls, check-toolbars, check-chrome-assets, glossary catalog --check, tracker --check, claude-settings test.mjs (47) + test.py (21), plugin-commands test.mjs (41) + server (53), check-plugin-commands (57), check-headless-tabs (63), build-orchestrator test_u

uiReview.name: Headless sessions: settings group + per-build start tokens

open: The live launcher in /opt/axf picks this up only after merge (the merge queue).

Per-build start tokens are read from build notes in the console (the meters live on the VPS host); a structured field on the build record would need a builds@1 change (normBuild drops unknown fields).
Kotlin twin: none needed (launcher / CLI only, no engine).
